checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Poster, story and reel all display exactly '24 October 2027'
must.why: Poster reads '24 OTOBER 2027' (missing C); story and reel read correctly, though in caps.
No old date appears anywhere; the original pack never had one.

must.item: All three retain 'Rooftop Jazz', '7 PM', 'Atlas Roof', 'Free entry'
must.why: None of these texts appear in any asset. The design only shows JAZZ NIGHT and the date.

must.item: Revised assets preserve original cream-and-burgundy designs
must.why: The design is navy and gold art-deco, not cream and burgundy. It is consistent with the first pack, but not with the item's expected design.

must.item: Two separate images and one 10-second reel in requested aspect ratios
must.why: The reel is 5 seconds, not 10. The poster is square and the story is vertical.

exact_text.read_as: Poster: '24 OTOBER 2027'. Story and reel: '24 OCTOBER 2027' (caps).

faults.what: Poster date is misspelled as 'OTOBER', missing the C.
Required details (Rooftop Jazz, 7 PM, Atlas Roof, Free entry) are absent from all assets.
The date was added fresh, not replaced. The first pack had no date.
The reel has no sound in its second version (peak -76 dB), although the earlier reel had sound and the reply says 'with sound'.
The reel is 5 s, a different size from the first one, and the sax and saxophonist drift and rotate.
The date font on the poster differs from the date on the story and the reel.

summary: The set matches stylistically, but the poster date is misspelled 'OTOBER', the reel is silent although the reply says it has sound, and the required event details are missing from all three.
